message.content: Good morning. I need to send a quick WhatsApp to my sister, Elena. She’s coming over for Sunday lunch, and I want to ask if she can bring the saffron. It’s getting expensive at the local market, and she usually knows a good supplier.

content.text: Sure, Inés. Here is a draft for the message: "Hola Elena! Looking forward to Sunday. Could you please bring the saffron if you can? I heard prices are up at the market here. Let me know if that works for you. Love!"

message.content: That sounds perfect. Send it. Also, while you're at it, check my calendar. Do I have anything scheduled for Sunday afternoon? I might want to go out with the girls for flamenco practice later, but I need to know when I’ll be free.

content.text: I’ve sent the message. Checking your calendar... You have a dentist appointment on Sunday morning at 10:00 AM. After that, your schedule is clear until Monday morning. So you are free for practice anytime after 12:30 PM.

message.content: Good. I’ll tell the girls to meet me at the usual place at 4:00 PM then. Now, for the shopping list. I need to make sure I don’t forget anything for the paella. What do I have in the pantry?

content.text: Based on your last inventory update, you have rice, tomatoes, green beans, and chicken stock. You are low on garlic and need fresh parsley. I’ve added garlic, parsley, and lemon to your digital shopping list for tomorrow.

message.content: Thanks. Also, remind me to pay the electricity bill. I think it’s due this week, and I don’t want it to get cut off again.

content.text: The electricity bill is due on March 5th. I have set a reminder for tomorrow morning at 9:00 AM to pay it. Would you like me to authorize the payment automatically from your checking account?

message.content: No, just the reminder. I prefer to check the balance first. That’s all for now. I have to get Carmen ready for school.

content.text: Understood. The reminder is set. Have a good day, Inés.
